# Hodie
> A thank-you notice to Saint Expedite, in English and Thai. Posted Monday 9 November 2026, Chiang Mai. Asked Friday 6 November 2026 for a Non-B visa stamp within 24 hours; the stamp is dated Thursday 22 October 2026, 15 days before the ask.

- Two todays: the posting day (Monday 9 November 2026) beside the reader's own today, live, with their clock and time zone
- Record: timeline of the ask (Friday 6 November, 19:12) and the stamp (Thursday 22 October)
- Ex: ten ex- words, each with a fact about the saint
- Clock: 18th-century German and Austrian pictures show him pointing at a clock or sundial
- Saint: the crow says cras (tomorrow), he says hodie (today); feast 19 April; Graz engraving with James 4:13
- Today: write a need, get it stamped with yesterday's date
- Offerings: pound cake, red flowers, red candle, red Fanta, coins, water, 1,000 prayer cards, a public thank-you
- Thanks: write and copy a public thank-you
